PLAN-A (Bronze plan) — §1 About this plan

The Bronze plan is a group health and dental plan for employees and their eligible dependents. It reimburses a share of eligible expenses after any deductible, up to the maximums in this booklet. Benefits are paid in Canadian dollars. The benefit year is the calendar year (January 1 to December 31), and annual maximums reset on January 1.

This booklet describes what the plan covers. It does not give medical advice. Decisions about your care should be made with a qualified health professional.
